Fiveandahalf is another who switched to bumpers after a promising hurdle debut, in his case winning at Ballinrobe in the spring, and he's feared most ahead of Gordon Elliott's Thinkitdontjinxit . races.verdict: WESTERN MODEL won over hurdles in July before running well when second at Downpatrick last month and is likely better than his third at Sligo suggests 2 weeks ago. He makes plenty of appeal at a course he's gone well at previously. Harbour Highway shaped as if ahead of his mark at Listowel and the drop back in trip rates a plus in a switch of headgear. Aurea Fortuna should be fitter after his recent fourth. WESTERN MODEL (IRE) HARBOUR HIGHWAY (IRE) AUREA FORTUNA (IRE)

Chase debutants Tell The Tale and My Own Lovely Lee are others to factor in, with Wannabe and The Magus others likely players if ready to roll on their respective returns to action. races.verdict: SINNATRA has to concede chunks of weight all round but he sets a good standard here on his achievements over hurdles as a novice, not least his excellent second in Grade 1 company at Aintree during the spring. He's every inch the type to take to chasing and is fancied to prove up to the task. Pourquoi Pas Papa had a really productive first season over hurdles and goes chasing with the Paul Nicholls team among the winners so he's next best, ahead of Light Fandango . SINNATRA (IRE) POURQUOI PAS PAPA (FR) LIGHT FANDANGO (IRE)
